reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness desktop mascot and UI enhancement plugin with draggable animated interactions, settings, games, achievements, local persistence, and optional weather integration; its installation script can modify and back up host frontend resources.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加可拖拽的鲸鱼娘桌面看板娘，并提供互动、小游戏、养成、成就、设置和可选天气功能。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable whale mascot to DeepSeek Harness with interactive animations, mini-games, progression, achievements, settings, and optional weather features.

capabilities: Injects a draggable animated mascot UI into DeepSeek Harness
Adds local interaction, game, achievement, settings, and persistent state features
Reads host frontend resources and can modify them through an installation script with backup and rollback
Can optionally access weather data through a configured external API
